comment: Each kit's finish on the stage and slot cards (blender-kit.py kit=<id>). Colours are linear RGB. shell and snare: style lacquer | pearl | stain | sparkle | metal, color, and color2 (the pattern's other colour). hoops: chrome | black | brass, or a material like shell. kickHoop: the kick's wooden hoops, like shell (default: the shell's). lugs: chrome | black | brass. heads, reso: colours of the batter heads and the kick's front head. Kits not listed keep the default red; presets use their base kit's finish.
